About us

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.

Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships with LALIGA and MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

Infrastructure and Middleware Delivery
• Responsible for the full-process delivery of middleware clusters such as ES, Kafka, and RocketMQ: resource application, network connection (VPC/Security Group/White List/DNS), zero-trust access configuration, monitoring access.
• Responsible for the delivery and maintenance of the middleware cluster in the test environment, ensuring the availability of the use cases for multiple teams.
• Familiar with delivery scenarios heavily dependent on enterprise internal resource application and permission approval processes, and able to independently promote cross-team collaboration.
Monitoring and Observability System Construction
• Responsible for the connection and delivery of monitoring clusters for new environments (AWS new account, heterogeneous cloud, new EKS cluster), including database monitoring, CloudWatch collection, and development of custom collection scripts.
• Responsible for version upgrades and expansion/shrinking of existing monitoring clusters: upgrade of ec2-Prometheus version, expansion/shrinking and upgrade of kube-Prometheus node groups.
• Responsible for the daily operation, version upgrade, problem handling, and integration support with peripheral systems (notification robots, etc.) of the FlashCat (Night莺) alarm platform.
Alarm Governance
• Conduct daily hot spot inspection and drill analysis of alarms， identifying frequent/abnormal alarm rules and root causes.
• Communicate and push for alarm rule optimization， threshold adjustment， and label standardization with the business/development side governance parties to reduce invalid alarm noise.
• Produce weekly alarm reports and other analysis reports to support team alarm governance decisions.
• IV. On-duty and Fault Support (Daily On-duty Rotation)
• Middleware/Log-related： Maintenance of message middleware Topic， opening and reviewing of Kibana/Kafka UI account permissions， log collection configuration troubleshooting， handling of log parsing exceptions， new service log integration.
• Monitoring-related： Maintenance of collection targets， adjustment of alarm responsible persons， adjustment and shielding of alarm rules， customization of non-standard ports/paths for collection， assisting in the creation of Grafana dashboards.
• Fault troubleshooting： Unreachable alarm investigation (rule chain， notification chain)， abnormal location of alarm indicators， fault troubleshooting related to logs/intermediary middleware configuration.
• User support and consultation： Answering questions about log platforms， monitoring dashboards， alarm configurations， etc.， outputting/maintaining FAQs and operation manuals to reduce the consumption of repetitive consultations for the team.

What you'll need

• Proficient in basic Linux system operation and maintenance: Skilled in basic Linux system operation commands; Familiar with Kubernetes deployment services and pod troubleshooting.
• Have basic knowledge of networks (VPC, security groups, routing, DNS).
• Relevant majors such as computer science, software engineering, communication are preferred; 1-3 years of experience in operation/ Site Reliability Engineering/ infrastructure, with experience in on-duty in large-scale production environments is preferred.
• Familiar with the deployment, expansion, and common troubleshooting of middleware (Elasticsearch, Kafka, RocketMQ).
• Familiar with the monitoring system of Prometheus/Grafana, understand the writing and optimization of alarm rules (PromQL), and have experience using platforms like Nightingale/FlashCat or similar alarm platforms.
• Understand public cloud (AWS is preferred) and Kubernetes (EKS) basic operation and maintenance, with experience in cloud monitoring (CloudWatch) collection is preferred.
• Have scripting development ability (Shell/Python either), and can independently write custom collection/inspection scripts.
• Strong sense of responsibility, able to adapt to the 7x24 shift schedule, possess good fault emergency response awareness and cross-team communication coordination skills.
• Strong learning ability and document summarization ability, able to consolidate repetitive problems into FAQs/SOP.
Additional benefits
• Cloud operation experience preferred
• Experience in building or governing observability platforms (log/monitor/alarm integration) is preferred.
• Practical experience in alarm noise reduction, root cause analysis automation is preferred.

岗位职责：

基础设施与中间件交付
• 负责 ES、Kafka、RocketMQ 等中间件集群的全流程交付：资源申请、网络打通（VPC/安全组/白名单/DNS）、零信任接入配置、监控接入。

监控与可观测性体系建设
• 负责新环境（AWS 新账号、异构云、新 EKS 集群）的监控集群对接与交付，包括数据库监控、CloudWatch 采集、自定义采集脚本开发。
• 负责存量监控集群的版本升级与扩缩容：ec2-Prometheus 版本升级、kube-Prometheus 节点组扩缩容与升级。

告警治理

• 监控类：采集目标维护、告警负责人调整、告警规则调整与屏蔽、非标端口/路径定制采集、协助制作 Grafana 大盘。

etoro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries.

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.

On etoro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news.

You can find out more about eToro here.

eToro | Global Markets & 24/7 Operations

Financial markets never stop moving, and neither do the systems that power trading at eToro. Our Trading Systems team sits at the center of live market activity, supporting trading across global markets, multiple asset classes, execution venues, and both traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi) workflows.

We are looking for a Trading System Specialist to join our 24/7 operations team. This is a hands-on role combining trading, markets, technology, AI, and real-time operations. You will follow market conditions and risk, support and execute trading activity within defined procedures, investigate incidents, and help keep our trading operation running smoothly around the clock.

AI is central to how we want the team to work. We are looking for someone who is curious, agile, and comfortable using AI agents, skills, automation, and AI-assisted development to solve problems and build better workflows. You do not need to be a programmer or an experienced trader, but you should be eager to learn markets and technology quickly and turn ideas into practical solutions.

What You'll Do

• Monitor and manage real-time trading and production systems across global financial markets, including stocks, FX, commodities, futures, and cryptocurrencies.

• Monitor market conditions, pricing, liquidity, trading activity, positions, and risk exposures.

• Execute manual trades, adjust hedging parameters within defined bounds, and support trading operations across multiple asset classes and execution venues.

• Monitor and support TradFi and DeFi trading workflows, including execution, liquidity, hedging, transaction flows, and settlement across relevant venues and systems.

• Make operational adjustments to trading configurations in accordance with established procedures and risk limits.

• Investigate trading failures, system alerts, and operational incidents, assess their impact, escalate when necessary, and follow incidents through to resolution.

• Maintain operational discipline during live shifts, ensure timely follow-up on outstanding issues, and provide clear handovers to the next shift.

• Use AI tools, agents, and automation to investigate problems, analyze data, develop solutions, and improve daily operations.

• Build and enhance internal tools, dashboards, integrations, and workflows using AI-assisted development and automation platforms.

• Work closely with global teams, including Trading, Risk, Technology, Product, and Operations.

• Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, operational efficiency, and system reliability.

• Support the continuous expansion of our 24/7 production monitoring capabilities.

Please note: this is a 24/7 shift position that includes nights, weekends, and holidays

Requirements

• AI-first mindset: Genuine enthusiasm for AI and a practical understanding of how to use modern AI tools beyond basic chat, including AI agents, skills, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development.

• Interest in financial markets: Strong curiosity about capital markets, trading, and financial instruments, from traditional markets to crypto and DeFi. Eagerness to understand how global markets operate and develop practical trading knowledge.

• Technical curiosity and resourcefulness: Comfortable exploring new technologies, working with data and systems, and finding creative ways to solve unfamiliar challenges. A software development background is not required.

• Agility and fast learning: Ability to quickly adapt, independently learn new tools and concepts, and apply them to real-world challenges.

• Strong problem-solving skills: Analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate issues independently while recognizing when to escalate.

• Ownership and accountability: A proactive approach, willingness to take responsibility for assigned actions, follow issues through to resolution, and maintain high standards in a live operational environment.

• Teamwork and communication: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and cross-functional teams around the world.

• Excellent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• 24/7 shift availability: Willingness to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

• Data and spreadsheet fluency: Comfortable using Excel or similar tools to investigate, validate, and communicate data in day-to-day operations.

• Operational organization and attention to detail: Able to prioritize multiple live issues, keep accurate records, and provide clear, actionable handovers.

Nice to Have

• Trading experience: Professional trading experience, experience in a dealing room or financial institution, or active personal trading in financial markets.

• Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar platforms.

• Experience creating AI agents, custom skills, automated workflows, or integrations between applications and services.

• Familiarity with APIs, SQL, Python, scripting, or data analysis tools.

• Financial data, BI, or production monitoring exposure: Experience working with raw market or trading data, BI tools, dashboards, monitoring/observability platforms, real-time production systems, or incident management.

• Relevant education or practical background: Finance, economics, computer science, information systems, or another relevant field. A specific degree is not required.

• Knowledge of financial instruments, trading platforms, pricing, liquidity, hedging, or risk management.

• TradFi, crypto, or DeFi exposure: Familiarity with centralized trading venues, crypto markets, decentralized protocols, on-chain transactions, wallets, or settlement processes.

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.
   
   - Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.
   
   - Design resilience across model providers: routing, failover, retries, rate limiting and graceful degradation when a provider is slow, throttling or down.
   
   - Make LLM traffic legible. Build observability that shows latency, errors, token usage and cost by team, model and use case, so engineers can see what their workloads cost and where they're spending their time waiting.
   
   - Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.
   
   - Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.
   
   - Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.
   
   - Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.
   
   - Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.
   
   This is a Staff role. You'll set the technical direction for how the platform runs, not just keep it running. The platform is small enough that your decisions shape it directly, and used broadly enough that they affect every engineering team at Kraken.
   
   


SKILLS YOU SHOULD HODL

 - Extensive experience in site reliability, infrastructure or platform engineering, with a track record of owning high-traffic, business-critical services in production

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, a major cloud provider and infrastructure as code such as Terraform

 - Strong command of SLOs, observability and incident management, and the judgment to know which reliability work actually matters

 - Proficiency in Rust or Python, and comfort reading and changing a production service's code

 - Experience with API gateways, reverse proxies or traffic management: load balancing, rate limiting, failover and caching

 - Experience operating multi-tenant internal platforms, including authentication, authorization and per-tenant cost controls

 - Staff-level influence: you set direction across teams, write clear design documents and bring other engineers with you

• Make independent disposition decisions on the most complex alerts, documenting rationale to an auditable standard — for the highest-risk alert categories, dispositions are subject to QC sampling and senior review

• Perform background checks and contextual research on counterparties and entities linked to alerts using public and subscription databases

• Maintain clear audit trails ensuring all investigative steps, conclusions, and rationale are accurately captured in the case management system

• Liaise with entity MLROs on SAR filings, responding to queries and providing supplementary evidence where required

• Liaise with external counsel and regulators where required, under the direction of the Head of TM

• Mentor L1 and L2 analysts on investigation techniques and complex typology recognition

• Support thematic reviews of specific client segments, typologies, or products as directed by the Head of TM or QA and Governance

• Proactively identify process improvements and suggest control enhancements to strengthen detection and reporting capability

Requirements
• Minimum four years in financial crime investigation, transaction monitoring, or AML/CTF compliance, with at least two years conducting complex investigations and drafting SARs/SMRs/STRs

• Experience working in or with CFD brokers, forex brokers, investment firms, or fintech platforms offering leveraged trading products

• Demonstrated exposure to end-to-end TM investigation, alert disposition, and SAR/STR preparation within a regulated financial services environm

• Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to interpret complex transactional datasets across multiple accounts and entities

• Excellent drafting and case-writing skills — SAR narratives must be clear, factual, well-structured, and defensible

• Sound understanding of AML/CTF regulations, ML/TF typologies, and red-flag indicators relevant to online trading platforms, including deposit-withdrawal cycling, structuring, trade-based laundering, deliberate loss, and geographic and identity anomalies

• Independent decision-making on complex cases with the ability to distinguish genuine suspicious activity from unusual but explainable client behaviour

• High attention to detail, organisation, and accountability in documentation

• Risk-based mindset — this role produces the team's most consequential written output and is not a process-following exercise

As Senior Operational Risk Analyst, you will be a core member of Capital.com's risk function, reporting to the Head of Risk Management. You will run the operational risk cycle across the Group's Cyprus-regulated investment firms: the risk register, the business-wide risk assessment, the RCSA, the operational risk event register, and relevant reporting. ICT and digital operational resilience under DORA sit alongside that work, with framework direction and regulatory sign-off set by the Head of Risk.


Responsibilities:
• Operational Risk Framework and RCSA: Run the risk register, business-wide risk assessment and risk and control self-assessment cycles for each entity: collect and challenge first-line input, score likelihood and impact, assess control effectiveness, and carry each risk from inherent through to residual.

• Operational Risk Event Management: Maintain the operational risk event register: capture and classify events against the risk taxonomy, complete root-cause analysis, identify repeat patterns, and track first-line remediation through to closure.

• Operational Risk Reporting: Produce the monthly operational risk event report and the operational risk sections of the Risk Committee pack. Monitor key risk indicators against stated appetite and flag adverse trends before a threshold is reached.

• ICARA Contribution: Provide the operational risk input to the ICARA for each entity: loss data, scenario analysis, and the operational risk element of the additional own funds and liquidity assessment.

• Control Assessment and Testing: Test whether controls work rather than whether they exist: query platform and warehouse data directly to evidence risk positions, assess control performance, and substantiate event impact instead of relying on first-line summaries.

• DORA and ICT Resilience: Support delivery of the DORA programme across each regulated entity: maintain the ICT risk management artefacts, prepare the material for the ICT risk workstream, and track remediation actions through to closure, under the direction of the Head of Risk.

• ICT Incident Classification and Reporting: Prepare major-incident assessments against the DORA classification criteria.

• CT Third-Party and Outsourcing Risk: Carry out vendor and outsourcing risk assessments, prepare critical-or-important-function assessments, and track concentration across ICT service providers.

• Assurance Support: Prepare responses to internal audit findings, external readiness reviews and supervisory observations, assemble the supporting evidence, and track action dates with the owners.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with Operations, Technology, Information Security, Compliance, Legal and Finance so that risk outputs land in the governance process and escalate on the right trigger.

Requirements:
• At least 3 years in risk management within a regulated financial services environment, with a material part of it in operational risk: investment firm, bank, payment institution, or a consulting or audit practice serving them.

• Hands-on experience running operational risk framework cycles, including the risk register, business-wide risk assessment and RCSA, with likelihood and impact scoring, control effectiveness assessment and the inherent-to-residual step.

• Experience managing an operational risk event register: capture, classification against a taxonomy, root-cause analysis, and remediation tracking with first-line owners.

• Experience producing operational risk reporting and governance deliverables that reach a committee, a board or a supervisor, including key risk indicators measured against stated appetite, and readiness to own them as you grow into the role.

• Working knowledge of DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554), with exposure to at least one area: ICT risk management artefacts, incident classification and reporting, ICT third-party risk and the register of information, or resilience testing.

About the team

We build the platform that lists and settles event contracts on our CFTC-regulated exchange. That covers sports, crypto, and other real-world events.

Our systems take in data from several sports and market providers, turn each event into tradeable contracts, and settle them correctly once the event ends. Settlement moves real money, so correctness and auditability matter as much as speed.

We are moving the platform from Python and Airflow to Go services built around Postgres. You’ll help decide what the new platform looks like.

What you’ll do
• Own the design of Go backend services that list and settle event contracts around the clock.

• Lead the move of business-critical workflows from Python/Airflow to Go services and durable job processing, without breaking live markets.

• Design pipelines that take in data from multiple providers, match the same event across them, and reconcile differences accurately and idempotently.

• Build settlement logic that holds up when things go wrong, including:

• Late or corrected results

• Cancellations

• Voided markets

• Provider outages

• Race conditions

• Write and review design docs, set engineering standards, and lead technical decisions across teams.

• Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback.

• Take part in on-call, lead incident response, and remove the causes of recurring incidents.

• Work with trading, operations, compliance, and product teams across time zones.

What we’re looking for
Required

• 5+ years building and running production backend systems, with ownership from design through on-call.

• Strong skills in Go, or deep experience in another backend language plus a clear willingness to work primarily in Go.

• Deep Postgres knowledge, including:

• Schema design

• Migrations

• Query performance

• Transactions

• Isolation levels

• Experience designing distributed systems, including:

• Concurrency

• Idempotency

• Retries

• At-least-once processing

• Failure handling

• A record of leading projects that span teams and making sound architecture trade-offs.

• Clear writing, good judgment, and comfort when requirements are unclear.

Nice to have

• Experience with prediction markets, sportsbooks, exchanges, or sports data feeds, such as OpticOdds, LSports, StatsPerform, or Sportradar.

• Experience with ledgers, payments, settlement, or other systems where money is on the line.

• Redis, Kafka, or Postgres-backed job queues such as River.

• Python and Airflow experience, which would help with the migration.

• React/TypeScript.

• AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD.

• Experience in regulated environments, such as CFTC/DCM, FINRA, or similar.

• Startup or zero-to-one experience.

•

Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

•

Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.

Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.

Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.

Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.

Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.

Key Responsibilities
1. MarTech Architecture, Tracking, Auditing & Proactive Enrichment

•

Web Tracking, Debugging & Ad Signal Routing: Own the end-to-end web tracking architecture across Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Define and document Data Layer requirements for the engineering team to implement, and ensure accurate web tracking signals and conversion events are seamlessly routed back to key ad platforms via GTM.

•

App Tracking & MMP Integration: Partner closely with the engineering team to implement, test, and maintain tracking across mobile apps (AppsFlyer, Firebase) for SDK events and Server-to-Server (S2S) events. Architect a standardized event taxonomy, oversee SDK integrations, and manage overall AppsFlyer health.

•

Ad Platform Tracking Optimization: Take deep ownership of exactly how ad platforms consume our data. Partner closely with internal User Acquisition (UA) channel owners to unblock tracking bottlenecks, troubleshoot platform-specific signal loss, and proactively enrich tracking signals (e.g., passing backend LTV scores or customized events back to ad platforms). Act as the technical authority who translates complex media platform requirements into actionable tracking solutions to maximize campaign performance.

•

Comprehensive Stack Auditing & Enrichment: Lead end-to-end audits of the tracking and reporting foundation to resolve data gaps, latency issues, and discrepancies across tracking tools, internal BI, and ad platforms. Move beyond routine maintenance by establishing automated QA monitoring to instantly detect event drop-offs or tracking anomalies, while strictly managing privacy-centric tracking and consent routing.

2. Advanced Measurement, Attribution & Incrementality Analysis

•

Attribution Strategy & MMM: Support the build of measurement solutions across the full attribution spectrum—from foundational models (Last-Touch) to advanced frameworks (Multi-Touch Attribution [MTA] and Media Mix Modeling [MMM]). Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ensure clean, structured signal data is feeding into these models. Help operationalize these measurement models and triangulate insights across these frameworks and growth metrics to evaluate true user acquisition performance.

•

LTV & Cohort Analytics: Analyze user acquisition performance, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and user cohorts. Translate these complex data sets into actionable insights to scale high-performing channels and inform broader growth strategies.

•

Incrementality Testing & Analysis: Support the design, implementation, and analysis of incrementality tests to measure the true causal impact of growth efforts and validate overall ROI.

3. Data Engineering Collaboration & Advanced BI

•

Data Pipeline Collaboration: Partner with Data Engineering to manage growth data requests, ensuring event streams are clean, structured, and accurately mapped into growth data pipelines.

•

Advanced SQL & Data Modeling: Write complex SQL to mine large datasets, build custom tables, and execute high-velocity ad-hoc analysis.

•

Dashboarding & AI Automation: Build and maintain automated dashboards using Tableau and Databricks. Integrate AI Agents to streamline reporting workflows and surface deeper, more actionable insights for leadership and business teams.

4. Cross-Functional Project Management

•

Technical Translation: Collaborate with Growth, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate complex marketing and analytics use cases into precise technical requirements and actionable project tickets.

•

Internal Documentation: Create, scale, and maintain comprehensive internal documentation covering our tracking architecture, event taxonomies, and growth data schemas.

Requirements
•

Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Statistics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.

•

4+ years of dedicated experience in MarTech tracking, growth analytics, and digital marketing data analysis. Experience in Crypto, FinTech, or Technology is a strong plus.

•

Deep, hands-on proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM), with the ability to define Data Layer requirements, route ad tracking signals, and debug network setups.

•

Deep expertise in ad platform signals and mechanics. You must know exactly how ad platforms consume data and have hands-on experience solving platform-specific tracking challenges, including Meta CAPI, AEM, Google conversion signals, event postbacks to DSPs and ad networks.

•

Deep expertise in mobile app tracking, specifically with AppsFlyer and Firebase, including experience standardizing event taxonomies and overseeing both SDK and Server-to-Server (S2S) event integrations.

•

Understanding of advanced attribution frameworks (MMM, MTA) and proven experience designing and executing incrementality tests (holdouts, conversion lift studies).

•

Understanding of digital marketing economics, including user acquisition optimization, customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), cohort analysis, and paid media strategies.

•

Understanding of CDP/CRM tools (e.g., Segment, Braze) and how they route data signals to downstream channels and systems.

•

Understanding of privacy-centric tracking mechanisms (e.g., Google Consent Mode, SKAdNetwork).

•

Advanced SQL skills for mining large datasets, creating custom tables, and executing ad-hoc analysis, alongside mandatory hands-on experience with Databricks and Tableau.

•

Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex marketing and business needs into precise technical tickets for Engineering and Data teams.

•

Strong organizational skills with experience building comprehensive internal technical documentation and managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced environment.

Your Role in Our Mission
As the Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you’ll be the dedicated owner of database reliability across our real-money trading products, operating within a multi-region AWS environment with multi-terabyte databases and tables containing hundreds of millions of rows. As our Senior Database Reliability Engineer, you’ll combine hands-on database engineering with technical leadership, driving performance, recoverability, and operational excellence across our data tier. You’ll establish engineering standards, mentor junior engineers, lead critical database incidents, and work closely with engineering and business leaders to ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable, secure, and ready to scale.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Database Performance & Architecture
•
Own query performance and latency across Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL through execution-plan analysis, indexing strategies, and database statistics optimization.
•
Design and implement partitioning, sharding, and data lifecycle strategies for high-volume tables.
•
Identify and remove unused or redundant indexes to improve database efficiency.
•
Build zero-downtime archiving pipelines using S3, Parquet, and Athena while keeping seven years of compliance data queryable.
Reliability, Recovery & Incident Management
•
Own disaster recovery across the data tier, including Aurora Global Database, cross-region replication, and failover automation.
•
Define, test, and track recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) through regular disaster recovery drills.
•
Maintain replication, backup, and point-in-time recovery (PITR) health, including routine restore testing.
•
Lead data-tier incidents as incident commander, coordinate response efforts, make informed recovery trade-offs, and drive blameless root-cause analyses.
Safe Database Changes & Infrastructure
•
Lead safe schema and data migrations on live tables using online DDL, expand-contract patterns, and AWS DMS/CDC where appropriate.
•
Own caching reliability across ElastiCache/Redis, including invalidation strategies, TTL hygiene, and failure handling.
•
Manage database configuration and infrastructure as code using Terraform.
•
Define and monitor data-tier SLIs and SLOs, building effective observability and alerting with Datadog or similar tools.
Technical Leadership & Collaboration
•
Establish standards for schema reviews, migration safety, database access control, and change governance.
•
Mentor and coach junior database reliability engineers, review their work, and help them develop sound technical judgment.
•
Partner with application engineering, data engineering, and product leaders to identify risks arising from query patterns and schema design.
•
Own the data-tier roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering leadership and the CTO.
•
Contribute to hiring, capacity planning, and the continued development of our database reliability function.

What You Bring
•
8–10 years in database engineering, database reliability engineering, or site reliability engineering, including several years owning production databases at multi-terabyte scale.
•
Strong hands-on knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL; experience with Aurora/RDS is strongly preferred.
•
Daily experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf beyond basic prompts and autocomplete. You can configure project-level instructions and rules files, delegate tasks to AI agents, and integrate AI into code reviews while independently validating its outputs.
•
Production experience with partitioning, sharding, and archiving large tables.
•
Direct experience executing database failovers or recovery drills, with measured RTO/RPO targets.
•
A methodical approach to diagnosing issues before making changes, validating solutions on replicas, and protecting production data.
•
Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting, Terraform, and infrastructure automation.
•
Experience with Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or comparable monitoring and alerting tools.
•
Experience mentoring engineers, leading production incidents, and making sound decisions while remaining hands-on.
•
Ability to explain technical risks, recovery trade-offs, and database priorities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Your X-Factor
•
Daily hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Windsurf, going beyond basic chatbot prompts and code autocomplete.
•
Experience setting up project-level AI instructions and rules files, such as CLAUDE.md, and delegating tasks to AI agents.
•
Ability to integrate AI into code reviews, identify potential issues, and independently validate AI-generated outputs.
•
A strong understanding of AI safety in database engineering, including reviewing AI-generated SQL and testing changes on replicas before considering them for production.

Your Journey after Applying

30 minute HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team member
•
45 minute Problem Solving Interview

• Contribute to visual systems. Work within and contribute to OKX’s visual systems, including shared illustration styles, motion tokens, color systems, iconography, layout patterns, UI components, and design tokens. Your work should strengthen the system, not create one-off exceptions. Think in terms of reusable, scalable assets and patterns, not just individual

• Bridge brand and product. Translate brand direction into in-product visual experiences. Work with the Brand Design team to ensure that visual identity is consistent from marketing to core product, while adapting it thoughtfully to product goals, user needs, and performance metrics. You’ll help create room for the product’s own visual expression without going off-brand.

• Design product campaigns and key moments. Create engaging visual experiences for in-product campaigns, launches, and feature moments. These should feel distinctive and expressive while remaining native to the product experience and aligned with the broader brand.

• Use AI tools in your design workflow. Actively integrate AI into your daily practice using generative tools for ideation, exploration, variation, prototyping, and asset production. You’re expected to experiment with AI-assisted workflows and bring what works back to the team. This is a core part of how we work, not an optional extra.

• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with product designers, engineers, and product managers to ensure visual design decisions are grounded in user needs and technically feasible. Participate in design reviews, give and receive critique constructively, and communicate your rationale clearly.

• Pitch and present. Propose creative concepts to team leads and stakeholders. Articulate the reasoning behind visual choices, not just what you designed, but why it is the right solution for the user and the brand.

What We Look For In You

• 4–6 years of experience in visual design, UI design, a digital-focused role within a brand team, or a related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong craft, modern taste, and attention to detail.

• Experience taking product experiences from wireframes to polished, production-ready UI. You understand how visual design supports usability, hierarchy, trust, product goals, and measurable outcomes, not just aesthetics.

• Strong UI and digital design fundamentals across product, responsive web, and mobile experiences. Mobile-first experience is essential.

• Exceptional visual craft across typography, color, composition, layout, interaction, and detail. You have a clear point of view, make thoughtful design decisions, and care about the polish that separates good from great.

• Experience creating or contributing to scalable design systems. You understand tokens, components, patterns, and how to create a coherent visual language across a product.

• Comfortable working at the intersection of brand and product. You can translate brand direction into product experiences that meet user and business needs while leaving room for distinctive product expression.

• AI-forward in your practice. You actively use generative tools for ideation, exploration, prototyping, and production, and are excited to experiment with new workflows. You use AI with strong creative judgment, refining outputs rather than relying on unedited generated assets, and look for ways to make visual work more scalable.

• A clear, collaborative communicator who can articulate design rationale and work effectively with product designers, engineers, product managers, and Brand Design.

• Proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools, with the ability to communicate interaction and motion intent through high-fidelity prototypes.

• Experience creating light animation is a strong plus. Experience with 3D software or a genuine willingness to learn is also highly valued.

What Sets You Apart

•

Experience designing for fintech, crypto, or trading platforms — you understand the visual language of trust, precision, and data density.

•

Strong visual. illustration and interaction idea skills — you can create original visual assets, not just compose them.

•

An exceptional eye for layout, composition, and hierarchy. You can turn ideas into clear, high-quality visual solutions quickly and decisively.

•

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing speed with a high bar for craft and attention to detail.

•

Experience working with globally distributed teams across offices and time zones.

• Familiarity with how visual design integrates with front-end implementation. You understand CSS, design tokens, and component architecture well enough to collaborate effectively with engineers.

Competitive total compensation package

Compliance at eToro UK is being rebuilt AI-first. In this role, you will work on regulatory change, product governance, financial promotions, and complaints, and you will redesign how that work gets done. Expect AI-assisted regulatory horizon scanning, automated first-pass promotion review, and data-driven complaint root cause analysis, all running within a controlled, auditable framework.

You will use AI every day, decide what it should and should not do, and remain accountable for the judgement calls that must stay human. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders, and translate complex requirements into effective policies, controls and business processes.

You will work closely with the UK Head of Compliance, senior management, Group Compliance and first-line teams, in a lean UK team where your impact is visible from day one.

How AI shapes this role

We want a compliance professional who can build and run AI-enabled workflows, not just request them. The role will combine AI-enabled execution with human review, professional judgement and escalation. The precise allocation will develop as the operating model matures:

Area

AI-enabled (you design, run and QA)

Human-led (you own the judgement)

Regulatory change

Horizon scanning, rule-to-policy mapping, gap analysis, implementation tracking, first drafts of briefing papers

Interpretation of ambiguous requirements, FCA engagement, regulatory submissions

Financial promotions

Automated first-pass review against FCA rules and house standards, issue flagging, MI on approvals

Final approval, novel or higher-risk promotions, sign-off accountability

Complaints

Triage, classification, drafting support, root-cause and theme analytics

FOS engagement, complex or vulnerable-customer cases, redress decisions

Monitoring and MI

Automated testing, continuous controls, reporting and dashboards

Control-effectiveness conclusions, escalation of material risks

Product governance

Customer-outcome analysis from complaints, incidents and customer data

Constructive challenge to first line, fair-value and target-market judgement

Responsibilities:

AI-enabled compliance

• Build, operate and quality-assure AI-enabled compliance workflows within an appropriately controlled and auditable framework.

• Assess which compliance processes are suitable for automation and when human judgement is required for review or approval.

• Test AI outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency and bias, and document the controls applied.

• Escalate unreliable, ambiguous or higher-risk outputs rather than relying on automated conclusions.

• Help develop practical standards for the safe and effective use of AI across UK Compliance.

Regulatory change and implementation:

• Support the assessment and implementation of regulatory developments affecting eToro UK, including the upcoming FCA cryptoasset regulatory regime.

• Translate regulatory requirements into practical policies, procedures, controls, governance arrangements and business requirements.

• Maintain regulatory implementation plans, coordinating actions with relevant owners and ensuring progress is documented and evidenced.

• Identify regulatory gaps and coordinate remediation across Compliance, Legal, Product, Operations and other relevant stakeholders.

• Prepare briefing papers, management information and updates for senior management and relevant governance committees.

• Provide analysis and drafting support for regulatory submissions, FCA engagement and responses to regulatory requests, escalating areas requiring senior judgement.

Product governance and customer outcomes:

• Provide compliance input into the design, approval, review and ongoing oversight of products, services and material product changes.

• Support target-market analysis, product reviews, fair-value assessments and customer-outcome assessments.

• Assess the compliance and customer-outcome implications of new products, features, distribution models and business initiatives.

• Use complaints, monitoring results, incidents and customer data to identify themes and recommend product or process improvements.

• Provide constructive challenge to first-line teams and escalate material risks where appropriate.

• Support the maintenance of clear evidence demonstrating how Consumer Duty and product governance obligations are being met.

Compliance framework, policy and monitoring:

• Contribute to the development, review and maintenance of UK Compliance policies and procedures.

• Design and undertake risk-based compliance monitoring across regulatory obligations and business activities.

• Assess whether controls are appropriately designed, implemented and operating effectively.

• Maintain clear records of compliance advice, decisions, reviews, issues and remediation activity.

• Develop training, guidance and communications to embed regulatory requirements across the business.

• Promote consistent standards between UK and Group frameworks while ensuring UK-specific requirements are addressed.

Complaints:

• Manage day-to-day Compliance involvement in the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) complaints process.

• Liaise with the FOS on allocated cases and escalate complex, novel, vulnerable-customer or higher-risk matters appropriately.

• Analyze complaints, root-cause data and customer feedback to identify regulatory, product and process improvements.

• Prepare complaints-related reporting for Consumer Duty and other governance forums.

• Ensure complaints themes are appropriately reflected in product governance, risk assessments, policies and monitoring.

• Act as a key financial promotions approver for the UK entity, reviewing campaigns and providing proportionate, risk-based advice.

• Support the development of financial promotions procedures, guidance, training and quality-assurance controls.

• Work with the business to improve the efficiency and consistency of the financial promotions process.

• Monitor financial promotions activity and report material themes, risks and remediation to the appropriate governance forum.

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.

Role location and working style:

This is position is based in Limassol, Cyprus with an in-office and hybrid set up. Remote set up is not possible.

We are seeking an experienced Dealer to join our Dealing Operations team in Limassol.

This is a real-time risk, pricing, and execution role within a highly automated, technology-driven trading environment. The Dealer is responsible for managing client exposure, executing hedging activity, overseeing liquidity and pricing quality, and ensuring trading stability across asset classes.

The role operates within an advanced infrastructure leveraging AI-driven risk monitoring, automated pricing logic, and predictive analytics. Dealers are expected to actively utilize AI-enabled dashboards, intelligent alerting systems, and data-driven decision frameworks to enhance exposure control, optimize execution performance, and improve pricing efficiency.

What will you be doing?

• Monitor and manage real-time client exposure across CFDs, FX, equities, indices, commodities, futures, and crypto.

• Utilize AI-driven dashboards, automated alerts, and execution analytics to support exposure, pricing, and hedge decisions.

• Support automation initiatives and continuous improvement of data-driven risk monitoring and pricing processes.

• Maintain net open positions within approved risk appetite and internal risk parameters.

• Oversee pricing integrity across asset classes, ensuring competitive and risk-aligned spreads in line with market conditions and internal strategy.

• Monitor price feeds, markups, and liquidity provider performance to ensure accurate and stable pricing.

• Manage pricing adjustments during volatile market conditions, low-liquidity periods, and corporate/macro events.

• Execute hedging transactions with liquidity providers in line with exposure dynamics and market conditions.

• Monitor execution quality, including slippage, spread behavior, liquidity conditions, and fill performance.

• Track key market events, macro developments, and breaking news; adjust risk and pricing parameters accordingly, including overnight/weekend exposure management.

• Assess liquidity conditions and escalate abnormal market events.

• Produce daily P&L and exposure reports; analyze client flow, profitability, and pricing performance.

• Provide insights on risk concentration, flow trends, execution quality, and pricing efficiency.

• Collaborate with Quant and Technology teams to enhance dealing automation, pricing logic, and execution infrastructure.

Requirements :

• Minimum 2+ years of experience in a dealing, trading desk, or market risk management role.

• Demonstrated experience working with AI-driven analytics, automated risk monitoring systems, and data-assisted decision frameworks within trading or market risk environments.

• Foundational understanding of data querying or scripting concepts (e.g., SQL, Python) and ability to leverage AI-assisted tools for exposure and execution analysis.

• Experience operating within automated, technology-driven trading infrastructures.

• Hands-on experience managing CFDs and FX exposure within leveraged, multi-asset trading environments.

• Proven experience in real-time exposure monitoring and hedge execution.

• Strong understanding of derivatives, liquidity dynamics, and market microstructure.

• Ability to work shifts, including nights, public holidays and weekends where required.

• CySEC Advanced Certificate (required).

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic

 - Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication

 - Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows

 - Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes

 - Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time

 - Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results

 - Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems

 - Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems

 - Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems

 - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

 - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD

 - Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus

 - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards

 - Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders

 - You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

 - A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics

 - Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications

 - Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack

 - Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning

 - Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring

 - Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection

 - Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments





Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

工作职责 (Key Responsibilities)
开户、合规与法务流程管理（Compliance & Legal Support）
多平台 KYB 与尽调： 主导公司在各大交易所、托管机构及链上协议的机构开户（KYB）流程，独立编写并提交尽职调查问卷（DDQ）等合规材料。
合同拟定与法务协调： 负责做市协议（MM Agreement）、费用协议（Fee Structure Agreement）等商业合同的草拟与条款初审；高效协调交易所/项目方与公司内部法务部门，推动合同法务流程快速落地。
流动性表现与交易管理（Liquidity & Performance Management）
流动性指标管理： 实时监控并管理各交易对的交易量（Volume）、买卖价差（Spread）及挂单深度（Depth）表现，确保 100% 达成交易所及项目方的流动性硬性要求，合理管理平台的流动性预期。
异常排查与危机沟通： 当盘面出现由于技术、网络或策略导致的运营异常情况（如短暂掉线、插针、深度断层）时，作为第一接口人，负责向交易所和项目方进行专业的沟通、解释与危机公关，协助技术团队快速排查。
项目方与特殊活动对接（Project & Event Synergy）
项目方日常商务对接： 负责既有项目方的日常维护，就月度做市服务费（Monthly Base Fee）、营销活动下的对冲成本补偿（Hedging Compensation）进行商务谈判与落地，并针对公司提供的定制化/高风险流动性服务，谈判并争取合理的专项资金补偿。
营销活动承接与盘口微调： 承接平台理财、交易大赛或刷量活动期间激增的流动性需求。与外部 BD 团队商议活动期间的费用补贴，并配合内部运营/策略团队密切观察流动性表现，根据情况配合调整盘口参数与风险暴露。
平台跨部门协同（Internal & Ecosystem Alignment）
财务对接与对账： 负责与各平台财务部门对接，进行每月度/季度的交易成本、手续费返佣、做市收入的严密核对（Reconciliation）。
风控、BD 与上币对接： 与交易所/平台的 BD 与风控部门保持高频沟通，协调新币上线（Listing）、旧币下架（Delisting）以及突发交易量需求；推进新合同模板落地与新项目洽谈。
钱包与 OTC 法币搬砖： 紧密对接平台钱包及 OTC 部门。协调外部交易员/渠道，协助推进多国法币的 OTC / RFQ（报价请求）法币搬砖与出入金流转；对充提币延迟、卡单等异常情况进行快速反馈和处理。

任职要求 (Requirements)
行业背景与经验（硬性条件）：
本科及以上学历，金融、经济、法律、计算机等相关专业优先。
3 年以上 加密资产做市商（Crypto Market Making）、自营量化团队（HFT）或知名交易所的交易运营（Operations）或机构客户经理（RM）工作经验。
对做市业务全流程极其熟悉：擅长处理与平台/机构客户的对接工作，熟知交易所 MM 考核机制（Spread, Depth），并对做市策略有基本的了解和研究，理解策略的框架和逻辑。
优秀的英语听、说、读、写能力，能够作为工作语言与海外法务、进行严谨的商务及法律条款沟通。
专业与核心软实力：
抗压与危机处理能力： 24/7 运行，候选人需具备极高的心理素质，在面对“交易异常、活动流量暴增”等突发状况时，能有条不紊地多线协调。
情商与协调力：具备基础的合同意识与较强的商务谈判手腕，在月费、对冲补偿谈判中为公司争取最大利益。 能够游刃有余地在法务、财务、技术、外部项目方和交易所之间充当缓冲带与稳定器。

CMC is committed to recruiting, developing, retaining and motivating exceptional people who are talented, innovative and focused on delivering excellence. The Group’s values centre on:
• Put clients first
• Lead with quality
• Set the standards

More information about the Group can be found at www.cmcmarkets.com.

Background and Purpose of the Role
The Senior Compliance Analyst will support the Compliance Officer/MLRO in operating and maintaining the compliance framework of CMC Markets Middle East Limited, ensuring that the business operates in accordance with the DFSA Rulebook, DIFC laws, applicable UAE federal requirements and Group policies.

This is a hands-on generalist role for an experienced compliance professional who can work independently from day one. The role acts as deputy to the CO/MLRO, providing cover across compliance and financial crime matters, and supports the day-to-day work of the AML/KYC Associate.

Role Overview
The Senior Compliance Analyst takes ownership of core second-line activities, including compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting, financial promotions, client classification oversight, complaints, training and regulatory change. Within delegated authority, the role approves routine financial promotions and prepares DFSA returns and notifications for final review and submission by the CO/MLRO. CMCME serves Professional Clients, including corporate clients, and the role requires a sound understanding of the DFSA conduct and financial crime requirements that apply to that client base.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Advisory and Business Support
• Act as the first point of contact for compliance queries from the business, providing clear, practical advice and escalating matters requiring CO/MLRO judgement.
• Advise on the application of the DFSA Rulebook, in particular the GEN, COB and AML modules, and CMCME’s policies and procedures.
• Identify, record and escalate breaches, errors, control weaknesses and regulatory risks, and support root-cause analysis and remediation.
• Maintain CMCME’s compliance registers, including the breach, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, personal account dealing and outside business interest registers.
• Review new products, services, counterparties and business initiatives from a compliance perspective.
• Maintain effective communication with the UK Head Office and global Compliance teams.

Deputising for the CO/MLRO
• Act as deputy to the CO/MLRO, providing cover for compliance and financial crime matters during absence, within agreed authority and escalation arrangements.
• Provide day-to-day guidance to the AML/KYC Associate and carry out quality assurance reviews of onboarding and screening files.
• Where cover for onboarding or screening is provided, do not carry out quality assurance or monitoring of files you have processed yourself. Such reviews will be reassigned or completed by the CO/MLRO.
• Support the CO/MLRO in reporting to senior management and the Board, and in meetings with the DFSA, auditors and Group functions when delegated.

Compliance Monitoring and Testing
• Contribute to the design of the annual risk-based Compliance Monitoring Programme and deliver reviews in line with the approved plan.
• Carry out monitoring reviews and control testing, documenting work papers, findings and recommendations to a consistent standard.
• Agree remediation actions with the business and track them to completion.
• Oversee client classification, including Professional Client assessments and supporting evidence, client agreements and required disclosures.
• Carry out periodic reviews of client money and client asset arrangements, reconciliations and related controls, where applicable to CMCME’s licence.

Regulatory Reporting and Notifications
• Own the regulatory reporting calendar and prepare DFSA returns, notifications and submissions for final review and submission by the CO/MLRO.
• Prepare monthly and quarterly compliance management information and reports for the CO/MLRO, senior management and the Board.
• Maintain CMCME’s regulatory records, including Authorised Individual and Licensed Function records, and identify changes requiring DFSA notification or approval.
• Coordinate responses to DFSA supervisory requests, risk assessments and onsite visits, and to internal and external audits.

Regulatory Change and Policies
• Monitor DFSA consultation papers, Rulebook updates, Dear CEO letters, enforcement outcomes and other regulatory publications.
• Assess the impact of regulatory developments on CMCME and recommend changes to policies, procedures and controls.
• Draft and maintain compliance policies, procedures and the compliance manual.

Financial Promotions and Client Communications
• Review and approve routine financial promotions, website content, social media posts and client communications within delegated authority, checking they comply with DFSA requirements and are clear, fair and not misleading.
• Check that promotions are directed only at the client types CMCME is permitted to deal with, and that required risk warnings and disclosures are included.
• Escalate non-routine or higher-risk materials to the CO/MLRO for approval.
• Maintain the financial promotions approval log and records of sign-off.

Complaints and Conduct
• Manage the complaints-handling process, including investigation, documentation and resolution within required timeframes.
• Maintain the complaints register, identify recurring themes and root causes, and recommend improvements to controls, processes or client communications.

Training and Awareness
• Deliver compliance and AML training, including induction and annual refresher training, and maintain training records.
• Identify training needs and prepare compliance updates and briefings for staff.

Experience
Essential
• Approximately 3–5 years’ compliance experience within a firm regulated by the DFSA, FSRA, SCA or FCA.
• Working knowledge of the relevant regulatory rulebook (DFSA, FSRA, SCA or FCA), including conduct of business, financial promotions, client classification and AML requirements.
• Experience of compliance monitoring and testing, preparing regulatory returns and reviewing financial promotions.
• Sound understanding of AML/CFT and sanctions requirements, sufficient to deputise for the MLRO.
• Degree in law, finance, business, economics or a related subject, or equivalent professional experience.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, practical advice and constructive challenge.
• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet regulatory deadlines.
• Professional integrity and sound judgement.
Desirable
• Direct experience of the DFSA Rulebook and DFSA supervisory processes.
• Experience in online trading, CFDs, brokerage or investment services, particularly with Professional and corporate clients.
• A professional compliance or AML qualification, such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, ICA Diploma in AML or CAMS.
• Previous approval by the DFSA or another regulator for a Licensed Function or equivalent role, such as Compliance Officer or MLRO.
• Experience of supervising or guiding junior team members.
• Experience working in the DIFC and existing UAE residency.
